purpose: Internal evidence review and monitoring-design hypotheses, not project GHG risk or credit eligibility
mapping_semantics: Candidate-family membership, never owl:sameAs or assay equivalence

defaults.mapping_reference_version: accession register inspected 2026-09-26; original annotation database release unresolved unless run evidence supplies it
defaults.mapping_license: MethaNet-authored mapping rationale; referenced database rights remain separate and unresolved for external redistribution
defaults.pipeline_assay: fact_kofam_hits accepted_hit=true in dim_mag-selected run; threshold, score, evalue retained verbatim
defaults.mucc_assay: exact token in source DRAM kegg_id; source thresholds/version not reconstructed; not numerically comparable with KOfam
defaults.negative_meaning: No accepted panel event in an explicitly covered source annotation run; not biological absence, especially for incomplete MAGs
defaults.qc_controls: Report completeness, contamination, taxonomy authority and version. No taxonomic label grants functional validation
defaults.context_controls: salinity, sulfate, redox, oxygen, temperature, substrate, depth and season remain unknown/not_measured unless source-linked
defaults.complete_pathway_rule: Never infer a complete pathway from this marker panel. All assayed components means panel component support only
defaults.external_crosswalks: No unverified EC/GO/Rhea/ChEBI/ENVO equivalence; exact KO identifiers are source references, not independent biochemical evidence

selection.rule: For each lane, source habitat stratum and family, select the first two hit-bearing MAGs by canonical proteome_id, then all panel events in those MAGs; additionally retain all 134 historical MUCC MCR/CuMMO candidates, including quarantined candidates
selection.negative_examples: For each lane and family, first evaluated MAG with covered_no_accepted_hit; unassayed and excluded release units remain in full coverage ledger
selection.rna_selection: First source gene by each of six MCR/CuMMO KOs in each included/quarantined historical stratum; retain all 133 source sample columns for selected genes

families.label: MCR-family subunits
families.component_logic: all three subunits for panel support; cofactors, direction and full pathway unresolved
families.business_question: Which candidates warrant direction-resolving methane process validation?
families.direction_limit: Methanogenesis versus reverse methanogenesis cannot be decided from MCR alone
families.false_positive_control: Review taxonomy and phylogeny/active sites; keep unresolved MCR-family assignments provisional.

families.label: Copper membrane monooxygenase candidates
families.component_logic: three core subunits; exact substrate requires independent context
families.business_question: Could a putative methane-oxidation marker instead indicate ammonia or other alkane oxidation?
families.direction_limit: Historical source KO assignments retain substrate ambiguity; current database labels do not retroactively validate old calls
families.false_positive_control: Review subunit phylogeny, operon context, and taxonomy; require substrate-specific validation before treating an ambiguous monooxygenase hit as methane oxidation.

families.label: Soluble MMO hydroxylase alpha candidate
families.component_logic: single marker; other hydroxylase/regulatory/reductase components not covered by this family
families.business_question: Prioritize an alternative aerobic methane-oxidation candidate
families.direction_limit: Marker is not complete active sMMO
families.false_positive_control: Full complex and sequence context review

families.label: Methanol corrinoid methyltransferase candidate
families.component_logic: mtaB marker only; corrinoid/coenzyme-M transfer partners and terminal MCR not implied
families.direction_limit: Methanol utilization need not end in methane
families.false_positive_control: Inspect terminal metabolism and methyltransferase context

families.label: Acetate kinase/phosphotransacetylase context
families.component_logic: paired acetate interconversion markers; route direction unresolved
families.business_question: Prioritize acetate availability and fermentation measurements
families.direction_limit: Production versus consumption not resolved from these markers
families.false_positive_control: Other pathway context and substrate/flux measurements

families.label: Dissimilatory sulfite reductase family
families.component_logic: two catalytic subunits; accessory proteins and direction unresolved
families.business_question: Identify redox-process candidates that may alter methane substrate competition
families.direction_limit: Reductive versus oxidative Dsr requires context
families.false_positive_control: Phylogeny, dsr accessory genes and chemistry

families.label: APS reductase family
families.component_logic: paired subunits; sulfate activation and sulfite fate assessed separately

families.label: SoxB thiosulfate-oxidation candidate
families.component_logic: single component; Sox complex not declared complete
families.business_question: Prioritize sulfur-oxidation context in wetland monitoring
families.direction_limit: Potential component, not rate or net electron balance
competing_interpretations: isolated homolog without complete Sox machinery
families.false_positive_control: Require complementary Sox components for pathway interpretation

families.label: Nitrate reductase/nitrite oxidoreductase family
families.component_logic: core shared subunits; direction, membrane components and cellular context unresolved
families.direction_limit: Nitrate reduction versus nitrite oxidation unresolved
families.false_positive_control: Phylogeny, localization, companion genes and substrate assays

families.label: NO-forming nitrite reductase alternatives
families.component_logic: either marker alternative; complete denitrification not implied
families.false_positive_control: Downstream nor/nos context and nitrogen measurements

families.label: Nitric oxide reductase candidate
families.component_logic: norB marker, complementary electron-transfer apparatus unresolved
families.direction_limit: No N2O flux or balance inferred
families.false_positive_control: Sequence/context and paired N2O process measurement

families.label: Nitrous oxide reductase candidate
families.component_logic: catalytic marker; maturation/electron transfer and clade coverage unresolved
families.direction_limit: nosZ presence is not net N2O mitigation
families.false_positive_control: Catalytic motif/phylogeny review, maturation context and process assay

families.label: RuBisCO large-subunit candidate
families.component_logic: catalytic-family marker; form-specific small subunit and carbon-fixation cycle not implied
families.direction_limit: Not carbon sequestration, stock or permanence
competing_interpretations: different RuBisCO forms or physiological routes
families.false_positive_control: Phylogeny, phosphoribulokinase and full pathway context

families.label: Cytochrome-c oxidase subunit-I candidate
families.component_logic: single terminal-oxidase component; electron-donor pathway and complex completeness unresolved
families.direction_limit: No respiration rate or CO2 flux inferred
families.false_positive_control: Companion subunits, electron donor and oxygen measurement

families.label: GH5 carbohydrate-active enzyme family
families.component_logic: dbCAN family candidate; enzyme substrate and secretion not inferred
families.direction_limit: Family assignment does not establish extracellular location or net carbon loss
families.false_positive_control: dbCAN multi-tool evidence, subfamily, catalytic residues and signal peptide review

families.label: RNA-polymerase beta-subunit control
families.component_logic: single housekeeping-family control, not GHG-process evidence
families.business_question: Check extraction and source-annotation coverage without choosing only climate-associated positives
families.false_positive_control: Do not turn housekeeping detection into climate function

families.label: Hydrogenase subgroup context
families.component_logic: not assayed by this bounded mapping; subgroup-specific direction mapping required
families.business_question: Would H2 production/consumption clarify methane substrate availability?
families.direction_limit: Broad hydrogenase similarity is insufficient for direction
families.false_positive_control: Curated subgroup phylogeny and subunit context before extension

families.label: Iron-reduction pathway context
families.component_logic: not assayed: no single portable marker admitted
families.business_question: Would iron chemistry and validated electron-transfer machinery explain substrate competition?
families.direction_limit: Multiheme cytochrome alone is not iron reduction proof
families.false_positive_control: Organism-specific machinery and Fe(II)/Fe(III) process measurements
